title: Found after 169 years: HMS Erebus #FranklinExpedition
subtitle: Frozen Passage · Short 5/6
caption:
September 2014: a shape on the sonar in Wilmot and Crampton Bay. HMS Erebus, in only about eleven metres of water. Two years later, an Inuit hunter's memory led searchers to HMS Terror.
